Both menu families update through getCommandState so File and context labels remain aligned.",
        "The accepted enablement expression is !isVirtual && !isNNTP && (isServer || canCompact) && isCompactEnabled after aggregation. The patch description intends disabled mixed folder/server selection; no blanket type-only rejection is inferred beyond these actual capability predicates.",
        "The command dispatches account-wide compaction for a server and ordinary compaction for a folder. With no current folder, it iterates selected targets and dispatches by each isServer flag. The calls are not awaited; this loop does not prove serial completion of asynchronous compactions.",
        "Changed tests update visibility/enabled expectation data. The actual helper directly checks hidden/disabled state and checks localization only when expected l10n fields exist. These owned table changes add no direct assertion of compaction side effects or rendered singular/plural text. Later accepted expectation tables and command module names are separate phases.",
        "Comments explain the override/count relationship and mutually exclusive label items, but one comment says cmd_compactFolders while the actual command is cmd_compactFolder. That is a scoped explanatory-name mismatch, not a new global naming or accesskey rule. No live keyboard, menu or compaction run.",
        "Full shared Bug1984945 and D268496 were read, including all 27 actual inlines and both actual Old/New summary histories. The original trigger is a null folder on multi-selection File compaction. The primary explicitly says mixed-selection disablement already existed; summary wording changes do not credit it as new behavior.",
        "The review rejects encoding the All operation as numeric0 or a custom plural default. The localization reviewer explains plural categories can differ by locale. Final exact Fluent separates the All IDs from real-count 1/other variants, and the author adopts that source shape. The linked localization documentation itself remains unread.",
        "The old generic update helper is removed and its logic inlined. Comments name updatePopupForSingleSelection; folder/server replace obsolete a-for-argument names; selectedFolder replaces reuse of the outer folder parameter; count becomes folders.length. These are checked local naming and role clarifications, not universal variable or inlining rules.",
